note: Active Taiwan bank transfer bonuses, airline buy-miles sales and award sales; refreshed weekly. type transfer|buy|award. bank null = any bank (minus excludeBanks). bonusPer [miles, bonus] = bonus miles per full block; rebate = paid back in bank points, not miles (listed only). bonusPct 0 = fixed or capped bonus that the calculator cannot apply; listed only. registration true = the official page says you must register first (registerBy = last day to register), null = the official page does not say. creditBy = the transferred miles must reach the airline account by this day (only when the official page says so); the site subtracts each bank's slowest transfer time (holds.json) to show 最晚轉點日; without creditBy the transfer only has to be made by end. termsChecked = the day those fields were read from the official page. Ended promos move to promos-history.json (keep the whole entry). Award sales (type award, 哩程票特惠): discountPct = miles off; start/end = the booking (ticketing) window; travelFrom/travelTo = the travel window; carriers = operating airlines it covers (codeshares excluded); routes = [{ from, to, cabins }] one way, or [{ between, and, cabins }] both ways; a 2-letter code is a country, 3 letters an airport; cabins Y/W/J/F letters. Only official pages, never a blog summary. cashSales = official cash fare sales from Taiwan carriers for 查現金票 (start/end = sale dates, travelFrom/travelTo, from, to = airports, price text); cashSalePages = each carrier's official offers page, listed while nothing is curated.
